summary:
I submitted 7 scenarios covering all six causes, but no run results were ever shown to me, so none are confirmed.

Source reading showed two code paths of interest:
- **Per-line validation:** the inventory validation in `inventory-module.ts` checks each line alone, so lines that share one inventory item (OVS-PIECE and OVS-TWOPACK) are never added up. Attempts 1 and 7 test this.
- **Stale counter write:** `reserved_quantity` is written from an earlier read, which could lose an update when two servers run at once. Attempt 4 tests this.

The other attempts test:
- **Process-local lock:** attempt 2 races two servers on shared stock.
- **Duplicate completion:** attempts 3 and 5 complete the same cart twice or more, across servers and on one.
- **Stock location:** attempt 6 lowers stock after the cart is built and before it is completed.

The `no_missing_orders` and `no_orphaned_orders` checks have no scenario aimed at them, and I did not examine the order-link path (`payment-order-link`, cart-link creation) beyond skimming the complete-cart workflow.
